title: A manual Check over "Updated to Quill X" replaces Installed without acknowledging the changelog
trigger: After an update the Installed banner shows; in Settings press Check for updates (UpdateControl::of maps Installed to Check{busy:false}, so check_for_updates accepts it).
effect: State goes Installed -> Checking -> UpToDate; the changelog receipt is never acknowledged, so the banner/What's new comes back at the next launch. recheck_for_updates guards this for the timer only.
fix: Guard Installed inside check_for_updates (one place), or make Check unavailable while Installed

title: The 4-hour recheck turns DownloadFailed/InstallFailed into Available, and auto_download retries on its own
trigger: A download or hand-off fails; wait for the timer (recheck skips only Installed). The check result is Available, apply_check_result calls auto_download_update.
effect: Failed download is retried silently every 4 hours and the failure message is lost, against the control's own rule that a failed download waits for the button.
fix: recheck_for_updates skips every failed stage, or keep the failure in the stage the check returns to

title: Banner visibility is two fields: update_state==Installed and update_banner_dismissed
trigger: Dismiss the banner (flag true); only check_for_updates resets it.
effect: None today; the flag is reset in one place and read in app_render/mod.rs:342.
fix: UpdateState::Installed(release, Banner{Shown,Dismissed})

title: Checking and Downloading name detached tasks; the only cancel is an AtomicBool in the progress
trigger: check, download, redraw timer and the 4-hour loop are all .detach()ed; UpdateState::Downloading holds only DownloadProgress (held flag).
effect: Owner going away (lock, log-out) cannot stop them; the 4-hour recheck loop and downloads run while locked or logged out; results are applied by state shape, not by a held request id.
fix: Hold the Task in the stage (Checking(Task), Downloading{task, timer, progress}) so replacing the stage cancels it

title: Installing has no exit if the quit does not end the process
trigger: hand_off succeeds, state = Installing, cx.quit() is held up or refused.
effect: Button hidden and disabled (Restarting) with nothing to leave the stage; needs restart.
fix: Installing with a way out (quit failed -> InstallFailed)

title: A clip that failed once is never retried until an account switch
trigger: VideoPlayer::open errors (open) or the player reports Failed (frame): FileId goes into State::failed and stays.
effect: The still stays for the whole run even if the file is later replaced or the failure was transient.
fix: Fetch-like Clip{Failed{at}} with a retry after the file changes

title: Pointer is three fields (hold, pressed, hovered) reset together by hand
trigger: Press, hover and long-press on a widget; widgets_state::Pointer::release clears all three.
effect: None today (released when the widget leaves the screen or its runtime stops).
fix: enum Pointer { Away, Over, Pressed{button, hold} }

title: The three waiting launches (Searching/FetchingAttachBot/Adding) match the answer by bot id, not by the RequestId of the send
trigger: Open t.me/bot/app1, then t.me/bot/app2 of the same bot before the first search answers; mark_web_app_pending replaces the wait, but the older answer has the same bot id.
effect: take_search_for(bot_id) accepts the app1 answer for the app2 launch: terms/write-access decision uses the wrong app. The send's RequestId (matches!(sent, Some(Ok(_)))) is dropped.
fix: Awaited carries the RequestId from the send; take_*_for(request)

title: QualityPointer{Up,Down} is a bool for whether the press began on the quality line
trigger: Press on the quality line and release outside the window (mouse-up missed); later left-drag from the timeline over the quality line.
effect: Stuck Down lets a drag that began elsewhere set the quality.
fix: Fold into one gesture enum with StripGesture (Idle, Strip{..}, Quality)

title: Apps tab shows "Loading apps..." for Idle and a dead "Could not load" for Failed
trigger: fetch_grossing_web_app_bots is sent only from set_search_filters(Apps) and its Err is dropped (let _ =, search_ui/mod.rs:867); the send fails, or the first fetch fails.
effect: grossing stays Idle -> text says loading forever; Failed has no retry until the scope chip is chosen again.
fix: Render Fetch::Idle/Failed apart from Loading and give Failed a retry; surface the send error

title: RefCell borrow_mut in non-test code (slot_in)
trigger: open_pip_window window closure
effect: Panics only if re-entered while borrowed; none today.
fix: Cell<Option<..>> or return the view from the closure

title: RefCell borrow_mut in non-test code (slot.take)
trigger: open_pip_window after open_window
effect: Same slot as line 100.
fix: Cell<Option<..>>

title: title_badge.borrow_mut() guard lives to the end of the statement, across other_accounts_unread()
trigger: window_title_in_place every frame
effect: The guard is held over a call into another module (panic-safety rule 6); a re-entrant call would panic.
fix: Copy the badge count out first, then add other accounts

title: window_title_shown borrow()/borrow_mut() in non-test code
trigger: sync_window_title each frame
effect: Short scopes, no re-entrancy today; rule 6 still records them.
fix: Cell/RefCell with try_borrow or plain field on QuillApp

title: baseline: CheckoutView::sending (and dialog_open/paid/note/verification) are bools snapshotting the payment stage; InvoiceWatch rebuilds an Attempt enum from them by polling
trigger: Mini app opens an invoice; the checkout moves through sending, error, verification
effect: Stage lives in the payments state as bools and is re-derived from poll snapshots
fix: Read the payment stage as one enum (Checkout stage) from the payments state instead of five bools

title: InvoiceWatch only sees Sending if a 30 ms poll lands while the payment is out; a send that starts and is refused between two polls is never seen
trigger: Mini app invoice; person pays and the form refuses at once (note set) within one poll, then closes the checkout
effect: The app hears invoice_closed 'cancelled' instead of 'failed'
fix: Have the payments state report the last attempt outcome (Fetch-like stage with attempt id) and read it instead of diffing polls

title: LaunchFlow::{Searching, FetchingAttachBot, Adding} hold Awaited with no RequestId; answers are matched by bot id only
trigger: Tap a bot app link twice before the first search answers (same bot); the older request's answer satisfies the newer wait and the newer answer is then dropped
effect: Launch runs from the older answer; the newer one's window/context is not used
fix: Store the RequestId in each waiting variant and match the answer's request, as WriteAccess does

title: AccessStage::Granting(RequestId) is answered from the shared WebApps::emoji_access mailbox by bot id, not by the held RequestId; bot_permissions toggles write the same mailbox, and a successful turn-off also stores (bot, true)
trigger: Mini app asks for emoji status access (Granting) while the bot permissions panel toggles the same bot's switch; panel answer lands first
effect: Mini app is told access was granted (or denied) from the other toggle's answer
fix: Carry the RequestId in the mailbox answer (like WriteAnswer/phone_share) and take it only when it equals the Granting request

title: begin_vanish pushes a Vanishing for every id without checking an existing ghost for the same chat and message
trigger: Delete the same message twice before the first deletion lands (two delete requests, or from two windows)
effect: Two ghosts for one message: the dust is painted twice (doubled opacity) and both wait 10 s
fix: Replace an existing ghost for (chat, message) or skip when one exists (keyed map)

title: ROTATIONS thread-local RefCell uses borrow()/borrow_mut() (lines 104, 136) in non-test code
trigger: Re-entrant call into with_stored_rotation/rotate while a guard is held (none today; short guards)
effect: Panic if ever nested
fix: Use try_borrow/try_borrow_mut with early return, or a Cell-free map owned by the app

title: Canvases::read computes x + col as i32 and put_image computes x + col (i64) on widget-supplied x; overflow panics in debug and wraps in release
trigger: Widget calls getImageData/putImageData with x near i32::MAX / a huge float cast to i64::MAX
effect: Debug build panic; release reads or skips the wrong pixels
fix: Use checked_add/saturating_add and skip the pixel on None

title: wait_for_cancelable_child returns on a try_wait error (or a poisoned lock) with the child still in ExtractionStage::Running and never reaped
trigger: ffmpeg child whose try_wait errors during a sticker/video decode
effect: Child process left running until a later cancel; stage never leaves Running
fix: On error kill and wait the child and set the stage to Starting/Cancelled before returning

title: Tests wait on the wall clock: next() polls with std::thread::sleep(5ms) up to a 10 s Instant deadline, bluetooth_probe is 300 ms, timeout_ms is 400, and one test asserts elapsed >= 250 ms
trigger: Run the hybrid ceremony tests on a slow or fast runner
effect: Flaky or slow tests; violates the deterministic-tests rule
fix: Inject a manual clock for the probe and the ceremony timeout, and poll the event channel without sleeps

title: set_volume sets want_audio before reopening and never undoes it when Player::open fails
trigger: Open a clip muted (volume 0), then turn the volume up while the reopen fails (file locked/moved, decoder open error)
effect: The clip stays silent for good: want_audio is already true so the reopen is never retried, and the old silent player and sound=None are kept
fix: Make 'sound requested' part of the reopen result (set want_audio only after Player::open succeeds), or a stage enum Muted/Reopening/Audible

title: pending_step is a one-shot slot that seek, step_back, set_volume reopen and replace_refused never clear
trigger: Step forward one frame while paused, then seek (or step back) before the next pull
effect: The next take_picture shows the stale stepped frame before the sought/previous frame
fix: Clear pending_step in seek/step_back/reopen, or make the paused step a variant of the transport stage

title: LaunchFlow Searching/FetchingAttachBot/Adding answers are matched by bot_id, not by a RequestId held in the stage
trigger: Tap t.me/bot/appA, then t.me/bot/appB (same bot) before the first searchWebApp answers
effect: The answer for appA is taken as the answer for appB (same bot id) and drives the launch/terms box built for appB; Awaited holds no request
fix: Hold the RequestId in each waiting variant (as WriteAccess does) and take the answer by it

title: ask() and search()/add()/fetch_attach_bot() overwrite whatever stage is in flight
trigger: A named-app link is Searching, then the person taps a menu button whose bot needs the terms box (or the other way round)
effect: The first launch is dropped silently and its answer is thrown away; a Confirming box is replaced by Searching so the open WebAppConfirm box shows nothing
fix: Cancel the older stage explicitly (forget its request, close its box) or refuse the new launch while one waits

title: Gesture::Idle{dragged} is a one-shot slot nothing clears until the next press
trigger: Drag the PiP window by its picture, release, then activate a control button from the keyboard (on_click fires)
effect: VideoPip::button returns early because dragged() is still true, so the keyboard activation is swallowed until the next mouse press
fix: Consume dragged when the release is handled (a ReleaseOutcome) instead of keeping it in the idle stage

title: The sound's life is State::tap (Option<AudioTap>) plus AudioShared::detached (AtomicBool) kept in step by hand
trigger: Take the tap, let the output drop it, reattach
effect: sound_detached/reattach_audio_tap/audio() each re-derive the stage (Untaken, Attached, Detached) from tap.is_none() and detached; AudioTap::drop sets detached from another thread
fix: enum Sound { Untaken(tap), Attached, Detached } in State, with starved carried by the attached variant

title: PreviewStage::Looking{request} never compares its request; the answer is read from the session's BackgroundSearch state
trigger: Open a bg/ link preview
effect: drain_background_lookup moves Looking to Editing/Failed on Found/Idle whatever request produced it; the held RequestId is unused (the match is in apply.rs by Waiting(extra))
fix: Take the answer by the stage's RequestId from background_answers like Sharing does

title: Share is clickable while Sharing and the Blur box does not leave Sharing
trigger: Press Share, then press Share again or toggle Blur before the link answers
effect: A second click overwrites Sharing{request} (the first answer is dropped, one wasted getBackgroundUrl); a Blur change during Sharing copies the link for the old blur type while the box shows the new choice
fix: Disable Share in Sharing and reset Sharing to Editing (dropping its request) on a Blur change

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut in the dialog body closure
trigger: The dialog content closure runs again or re-entrantly while a borrow is held
effect: borrow_mut can panic on a re-entrant call; a second call also renders an empty body (take())
fix: Build the body inside the Fn closure or use a Cell-free take at build time

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut in the WebAppConfirm dialog body closure
trigger: The dialog content closure runs again or re-entrantly
effect: borrow_mut can panic on re-entry; a second call renders an empty body
fix: Build the body inside the Fn closure

title: Crop::mirrored subtracts x and w from 1000 unchecked on public u16 fields
trigger: A Crop whose x + w exceeds 1000 reaches mirrored() before clamped()
effect: Debug build panics on overflow; release wraps to a garbage x that clamped() then moves
fix: Use saturating_sub (as turned_cw does) or clamp first

title: The PIN channel is not matched to an ask: a PIN sent while none is asked stays queued and answers the next NeedPin
trigger: Submit the PIN twice (double click) with a wrong PIN
effect: ask_pin(true) takes the queued second copy at once without the person typing, burning another retry of the key's PIN counter toward PinBlocked
fix: Carry an ask id in NeedPin and the PIN, or drain the channel before each ask_pin

title: baseline: Lookup::pending (ask-for-another-frame flag set together with fade_started/made)
trigger: canvas lookup returns pending=true when a newer image is on its way or a picture was just made; the caller requests an animation frame
effect: no bug today; pending is derived from made||fade_started and nothing names the stage (Settled / Rendering / JustMade / Fading)
fix: enum LookStage { Settled, Rendering, JustMade, FadeStarted } on Lookup, with pending() derived

title: baseline: Lookup::fade_started (second bool that implies pending)
trigger: settle() starts a crossfade; fade_started and pending are both set by hand in ready()
effect: no bug today; two bools that must change together (fade_started implies pending)
fix: fold into the same LookStage enum as C3-001

title: Initiator::ephemeral Option is a 'first message sent' flag; process_response before initial_message returns None, initial_message may run twice
trigger: call process_response without initial_message, or initial_message twice (resets noise but replaces ephemeral)
effect: no bug today (only the hybrid ceremony calls it in order); the handshake stage is an Option plus a mutated Noise
fix: typestate: initial_message(self, ephemeral) -> (Vec<u8>, AwaitingResponse) and process_response on AwaitingResponse

title: A known Clip whose file entry is missing from media.files returns early, so nothing ever downloads it
trigger: UserpicVideo::Clip(id) is known (full info parsed) but session.media.files has no entry for id (entry evicted or never ingested)
effect: the userpic stays a still forever; should_download has a None => true arm that this early return skips
fix: treat a missing file entry as 'not downloaded' and defer UserpicFetch::Clip when should_download(clip)

title: FADES is keyed by wallpaper identity only, so two windows showing the same wallpaper share one crossfade picture
trigger: main window and a chat window show the same wallpaper; its rotation changes; each window's settle() inserts a Fade from its own window-sized picture, last writer wins
effect: one window may fade out a picture made for the other window's size (stretched) for 200 ms
fix: key FADES by (window, identity) or by slot

title: PresentEstimator::on_grid is a cached bool derived from grid, shared and cadence, written only inside on_grid()
trigger: set_grid(None) or a display change while next_due is None, so on_grid() is not called again
effect: request_lead keeps adding a quarter frame until the next on_grid() call; self-corrects
fix: compute on_grid inside request_lead from grid/shared/cadence instead of storing it

title: Failed translation counts as done: the pump never asks again (needs_translation is is_none)
trigger: Open a translated chat while offline or with a send that fails (abandon_translation, 'send'), or a TDLib error answer; go back online
effect: The message stays in the original for the rest of the session (until edit or history prune); no retry, though translate_message says 'a failed one is asked for again'
fix: Fetch-like stage with retry rule: Failed(at) retried after a backoff or on chat reopen; pump asks for Idle only

title: Toast stage is Option<TranslateToast> plus toast_seq, with its dismiss timer a detached task matched by seq id
trigger: Show a toast, show another; the old timer wakes and compares ids
effect: Works today; timer is not held in the stage so it cannot be cancelled with it
fix: Toast { .., timer: Task } held in the stage, dropped on replace/click

title: baseline: BackendStatus::failed bool sits beside ready/stalled/at_end flags that describe one backend stage
trigger: Backend reports failed and ready/at_end in one poll
effect: Machine takes failed first, so no bug today
fix: BackendStatus enum { Opening, Ready{..}, Stalled, AtEnd, Failed }

title: TransportMachine::wants_play is changed beside Stage by hand (Ended, seek from Ended, sleep, live) and must agree with it
trigger: Add a new state transition and forget wants_play=false
effect: Works today; each move of Ended/Paused sets wants_play separately
fix: Fold the intent into Stage (At/Landing carry Intent) so a transition sets both

title: LiveStatus::ended is Option<bool> used as a tri-state (None live, Some(false) ended, Some(true) failed)
trigger: Live feed ends vs fails
effect: Works today; readers must remember the meaning of the bool
fix: enum LiveEnd { Running, Ended, Failed }

title: QualityPointer is Up/Down with no data (a pressed flag in disguise); StagePress has a moved bool for press vs drag
trigger: Press on the quality line / stage, drag, release
effect: Works today; pointer stage lives in three separate fields (strip, press, quality_pointer) with no owner of 'which drag is live'
fix: One enum Drag { Idle, Strip{..}, Stage{press}, Quality } on EditorMotion; StagePress as Pressed/Dragging variants

title: Strip frames are three fields kept in step by hand: frames Vec<Option>, frames_width, frames_cancel; None means both 'not cut yet' and 'cut failed'
trigger: Frame render fails (render_strip_frame error) or width changes mid-cut
effect: A failed frame stays blank until the width changes enough; nothing shows it failed
fix: enum Frames { Idle, Cutting{width, cancel, frames}, Ready{width, frames} } with Slot::{Pending, Cut, Failed}

title: Rendered::complete bool marks a fill shown without its pattern so the cache retries later
trigger: Pattern file unreadable
effect: Fixed in last pass with retry_at, but the stage is still a bool
fix: enum Rendered { Whole(..), FillOnly(..) }

title: Warmed(bool) is a 'load started' flag beside the loader's own OnceLock result (Unloaded/Loading/Loaded)
trigger: Shim load fails or is slow
effect: Works today: one-shot per process, a missing shim is never retried; the stage lives in two places
fix: One DecoderLoad { Idle, Loading, Ready, Missing } global

title: A trust file that cannot be read is treated as empty, and the next mark_trusted/forget_account writes that empty set over it
trigger: The file is briefly unreadable (read error, not a parse of missing file); the user accepts one bot's box
effect: Every account's earlier mini-app consent is lost; each bot asks again
fix: load() returns Result; keep Missing vs Unreadable, and do not persist over Unreadable

title: The cover player is paused or dropped only from the main window's render (sync_video_avatar); with no main-window render it keeps its backend and plays
trigger: Open a profile with a video photo, then close or hide the main window to the tray while a chat window or tray runs
effect: Decode thread keeps running while hidden
fix: Drop or pause the cover from the window-gone/lock transitions as well (Farewell or upkeep), not only render

title: One gesture held as three fields: seek_preview, volume_dragging, speed_preview
trigger: drag the seek thumb, the volume thumb or the speed slider
effect: none today; dragging() ORs them and clear_clip resets each by hand
fix: enum Drag { None, Seek(f64), Volume, Speed(f64) } so a release/clear is one assignment

title: Space-hold boost: BoostState and its timer Task are two fields kept in step by hand
trigger: hold Space, release, change speed, background the window
effect: none today; boost_timer = None is written in viewer_key_up, cancel_viewer_boost, set_playback_speed, viewer_boost_tick and clear_clip beside boost.cancel()/release()
fix: hold the Task inside BoostState::Armed { timer }

title: WaitingGate holds since and timer as two Options changed together in observe()
trigger: a clip stalls then recovers
effect: none today
fix: enum Waiting { Idle, Delayed { since, timer }, Shown }

title: Edit range stored twice: VideoEdits from/till/cover in the dialog and Timeline from/till/cover in EditorStage::Ready
trigger: drag a trim handle or the cover head (video_editor_timeline.rs:425-428 writes both by hand)
effect: none today; a new writer that sets only one leaves the encode range different from the strip
fix: derive edits.from_ms/till_ms/cover_ms from the Timeline in the stage

title: Cover preview path and still can describe different frames: preview is replaced on every cut but still only when the decode gave a picture
trigger: change turns/flip or cover so a cut succeeds but load_still returns None (unreadable jpeg)
effect: the cover bubble/picture shows the older frame while the cover that is sent is the new one
fix: one Cover { at_ms, path, still: Option<OwnedImage> } replaced whole; clear still when the new one fails

title: user_paused bool and playback_ms Option beside the looping player: pause stage and position held as loose fields
trigger: click the picture to pause, drag the strip, press Done and fail the encode
effect: none today; encode_failed rebuilds Ready with player None while user_paused stays set
fix: fold into EditorStage::Ready as Playback { Playing, PausedByUser, at }

title: pending_seek is a one-shot slot cleared only by playing the matching clip or closing the viewer; reset_viewer_item_state (step) leaves it
trigger: open a media-timestamp link or change quality with autoplay off, step to another item and back
effect: the clip later starts from the old second instead of 0
fix: carry the start in the ViewerClip stage (Opening { item, start }) so a step drops it

title: Viewer pointer state drag (pan anchor) and over_controls bool are reset by hand at several sites (navigation.rs:207,276; playback.rs:628,635; overlay.rs:389; close only for over_controls)
trigger: pan a zoomed photo then step, or rest the pointer on a control and step/close via key
effect: over_controls stays true after a step until the next mouse move, so auto-hide is held
fix: one Pointer enum on ViewerUi replaced whole in reset_viewer_item_state

title: orientation and Reorient are two copies of the photo turn: orientation commits when the decode lands while Reorient::Decoding.target and the shown code are compared by hand (overlay.rs:188)
trigger: press Rotate twice quickly, or rotate a photo that is not downloaded
effect: none today
fix: Reorient owns the requested and the shown orientation

title: Pointer is hold bool + pressed Option + hovered bool, three fields reset together by release()
trigger: press and hold on a widget, then it goes off screen
effect: none today (release_pointer covers it)
fix: enum Pointer { Away, Hover, Pressed { button, hold } }

title: WidgetsUi::lander Option<Task> is a started flag: watch_widget_runtimes returns when is_some, nothing restarts it if its loop ended
trigger: the lander loop breaks when the app entity update fails
effect: widgets stop landing frames for the rest of the screen
fix: enum Lander { NotStarted, Running(Task) } with the loop's end setting a state the starter reacts to

title: The 2FA flow is split over two owners reset by hand together: TwoFaBox (view, confirm, notice, in OnScreen) and Session auth_state.twofa_flow (notice, code_wait)
trigger: open Two-Step, start recovery email, switch view or close
effect: none today; goto_twofa_view/clear_twofa_flow clear both, a new path that clears one leaves a stale code box or notice
fix: one TwofaFlow stage per account that the box view reads

title: Instant::now() + timeout is an unchecked Instant add (panics on overflow)
trigger: a ceremony passes a huge timeout (same in hybrid/flow.rs:133,247)
effect: process abort
fix: Instant::now().checked_add(timeout) with a fallback

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut on WidgetsUi::passes at 5 sites (72, 82, 93, 186, 211); begin_widget_pass holds the guard across defer_screen
trigger: a render pass (begin_widget_pass/note_widget, run during render with &self) re-entered while a guard from reconcile_widgets/widgets_left_window is live, e.g. a nested window render
effect: BorrowMutError panic = app crash
fix: plain fields mutated through &mut self (pass queue per WindowSlot) or a Cell-based API with no guard held across calls

title: PhoneFlow::Unblocking does not hold the unblock RequestId; the answer is matched by the chat's blocked flag and a 15 s timer, an error arm does not exist
trigger: mini app requests phone, user presses Share while the bot is blocked, setChatUserBlocked fails (network/TDLib error)
effect: popup is gone and the app waits the full 15 s UNBLOCK_TIMEOUT before hearing 'cancelled'; a failed unblock is indistinguishable from a slow one
fix: Unblocking { since, request: RequestId } finished by the answer/error of that request (as Sending is)

title: failed avatar encode returns the editor to Ready with player None and never calls start_video_editor_player (the tray/edit-box Err arm does)
trigger: open the video editor for a profile photo, press Done, let the ffmpeg encode fail
effect: editor is back but the looping preview is gone for good (only the still shows) and the cover/trim playhead no longer plays; docs/decisions says the avatar path refills the player but it does not
fix: one EditorStage transition (encode_failed) that reopens its player, or a shared failure helper used by all three encode callers

title: edits (turns, flip, crop, trim/cover via set_timeline) stay editable while the stage is Encoding; only Done and the bar's ready flag are gated by busy()
trigger: press Done on a video that needs a transcode, then Rotate, Flip, drag the crop or the strip while it encodes
effect: the picture shows edits the running encode does not have (it captured edits at begin_encode); on failure the Ready stage resumes with edits the failed encode never tried
fix: Encoding carries the edits it encodes and edits live only in Ready, so input in Encoding has nothing to change

title: user_paused and playback_ms sit on VideoEditorDialog beside EditorStage::Ready { player }, a playback stage kept in step by hand
trigger: player dropped and reopened (encode failed, clip failed) while user_paused stays set and playback_ms keeps the old position
effect: no bug today: start_video_editor_player re-reads both; paused badge needs user_paused && player.is_some()
fix: Ready { player: Playback::{Playing,UserPaused,None} } with the position inside it

title: Surfaces::pool and Surfaces::failed are two Options written together in target() (a pool for a size, or a failure for that size and time)
trigger: macOS live frame at a new size whose pool cannot be made
effect: no bug today; target() keeps them exclusive by hand
fix: enum PoolState { None, Ready{size,pool}, Failed{size,at} }

title: BgraPool Kept::released bool is the 'player shows NV12' stage, flipped by take()/release() and invariant with buffers being empty
trigger: clip alternates NV12 and BGRA pictures
effect: no bug today: release() empties buffers and sets the flag together, take() clears it
fix: enum Pool { Warm(Vec<Vec<u8>>), Released } or owned by the player's PixelOutput stage

title: turn_plane_into rotation-0 arm calls out.chunks_exact_mut(w * N) which panics when width is 0 (guards pass: packed == 0 == out.len(), plane_span ok for height > 0)
trigger: rotate_bgra called with width 0 and height > 0 from a decoder frame report
effect: panic in the decode/pull path = crash
fix: return false when width or height is 0 at the top of turn_plane_into

title: VideoPip keeps seek_synced and volume_synced beside the slider entity values and line_drag to tell its own writes from a keyboard/screen-reader step
trigger: slider set_value by sync_lines vs keyboard step
effect: no bug today; three fields must be updated at each write site (on_seek_event Release, on_volume_event, sync_lines)
fix: one Line { Following, Dragging{..}, Stepped } value per slider that owns the synced number

title: RuntimeEvent::Request sends getWidgetQuery to TDLib even when the entry has no live runtime (live_mut() is None), so nothing records the token
trigger: one land_widgets batch holds Stopped/Failed then a Request from the same runtime
effect: wasted TDLib call whose answer is dropped by answer_widget_query
fix: send only when live.queries.insert succeeded; otherwise fail the request locally

title: A launch whose helper never starts is never closed in TDLib
trigger: Open a mini app while the helper binary is missing, or the helper spawn fails, or its stdio pipes are missing
effect: The error note shows, but closeWebApp is never sent, so the bot keeps a live web app session on the server until TDLib times it out; the lock path alone sends it. The three early returns in spawn_mini_app_window (helper_path None, spawn Err, stdin/stdout None) skip close_web_app(launch.launch_id), which the locked path does send
fix: One `refuse(launch)` helper that closes the launch on every early return, or a Launching stage whose drop sends closeWebApp

title: A custom-method answer goes to whichever mini app window is open, not the one that asked
trigger: App A calls invokeCustomMethod, the user closes it and opens app B (or a link in A opens B) before TDLib answers
effect: B's page receives custom_method_invoked with A's req_id and result (cross-bot leak); A never gets it. custom_requests is keyed by request id to req_id only and is not cleared when the window closes. CustomRequestReply carries only req_id; poll_mini_app_session emits it to self.mini_apps.window.as_mut() without a launch/bot key, and close_mini_app_window leaves WebApps::custom_requests alone
fix: Key custom_requests by launch_id (or the window's launch) and drop the reply when the window is not that launch; clear the entries in close_mini_app_window

title: Search, attach-bot and toggle answers are matched by bot id, not the RequestId of the wait
trigger: Two named-app links of the same bot opened in quick succession (or an attach-bot link twice)
effect: The older searchWebApp answer, stored under the same bot id, is taken by the newer wait, so the newer launch uses the older app's skip_confirmation / request_write_access. take_search_for(asked), take_attach_bot_for(asked) and take_add_for(bot) compare the bot id; the LaunchFlow stage does not hold the RequestId it sent. The mailbox slots found/attachment_menu_bot carry no request id
fix: Hold the RequestId in each LaunchFlow wait variant and carry it in the session answer; apply only when equal

title: AgeCheck is a two-variant flag that nothing ever clears
trigger: Tap Verify my age (opens the bot), finish or abandon it; later the server asks for age verification again
effect: AgeCheck::Started stays for the whole run, so age_gate_blocks never shows the prompt again and Show 18+ Content is sent straight to the server; drain_account_notices closes the notice when the condition clears but not age_check, although its comment says the check is done. AccountBoxes::age_check is set only here (Started) and read at toggle_sensitive_content; no reset on condition cleared, account change is covered only by OnScreen drop
fix: Fold into OpenNotice/an Option owned by the age_verification condition (e.g. AgeVerify { started }) so it ends when the condition goes away

title: baseline: BackendStatus::failed beside ready, stalled and at_end
trigger: None today; BackendStatus is read each poll
effect: ready and failed are both read from one AVPlayerItemStatus and cannot be true together, but the type allows it; transport observe checks failed first. BackendStatus {ready, failed, stalled, at_end} (transport.rs:114) built in status() from one item status
fix: An EngineHealth enum { Opening, Ready, Failed } in BackendStatus

title: baseline: LiveInput::failed beside state and idle
trigger: None today; three call sites build LiveInput each draw (stream_view, group_call_tiles, story live_view)
effect: failed, idle and Option<PlayState> are resolved by priority in phase(); the host can set failed while the player says Playing. LiveInput {state, idle, failed}; phase() checks failed, then Ended, then idle
fix: A single LiveSource enum { NoPlayer, Idle, HostFailed, Player(PlayState) }

title: baseline: MiniAppWindow::closing_confirmation is listed in the baseline and the allow list
trigger: None; the app sets it with web_app_setup_closing_behavior
effect: The field is allowed with a reason in implicit-state-allow.txt, so the baseline line is stale. scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt still has MiniAppWindow::closing_confirmation
fix: Remove the baseline line (the allow entry covers it)

title: LiveOverlayClock keeps armed and timer as two options set and cleared together
trigger: None today
effect: armed (Instant) and timer (Task) are written together in arm() and cleared together in observe(); one can drift from the other if a caller edits one. LiveOverlayClock {phase, armed, timer}
fix: One field armed: Option<(Instant, Task<()>)>

title: A capture's paused stage lives in three places kept in step by hand
trigger: None today; pause()/resume() change them together
effect: VoiceCapture.clock (RunClock.since), Live.control (Handshake) and the mic stream's own pause/play are each moved by pause() and resume(); preview_path reads two of them, so a miss shows the wrong control or no preview. pause() calls clock.pause_at, control.ask_pause, mic.pause; resume() the reverse
fix: One Recording/Paused stage on Source::Live that owns the clock, the handshake and the mic

title: Non-test RefCell borrow/borrow_mut on the cached X11 connection
trigger: Any X11 call that re-enters connection() while forget_connection runs (not reachable today)
effect: A reentrant call would panic with already borrowed; both sites are short but unguarded, unlike forget_connection which uses try_borrow_mut. CONNECTION.with(|slot| slot.borrow().clone()) at 295 and slot.borrow_mut() at 305
fix: Use try_borrow / try_borrow_mut and treat a failure as no cached connection

title: The mini-app poll is a fixed 30 ms timer that also runs while the window is hidden or in the background
trigger: Open a mini app and minimise or switch away; leave it open
effect: The main thread wakes about 33 times a second for as long as the app is open (and the whole time a launch waits), while the rest of Quill sleeps on wake::Signal; helper events arrive on an mpsc channel that nothing pokes. ensure_mini_app_poll loops on timer(30ms) while window.is_some() || flow.is_waiting() || pending
fix: Poke a wake::Signal from the helper reader thread and the session answer path, and sleep on it

title: Notes::Loaded is never refetched
trigger: Open What's New, leave Quill running, a newer release is published and the update banner opens What's New
effect: The window lists the notes from the first open, without the newer release, until restart; only Idle and Failed load again. open_whats_new reloads only on Notes::Idle | Notes::Failed
fix: Loaded carries a fetched-at time (manual clock) or reload when opened after an update check finds a newer version
